name: prices stay quoted, cash stays home
notes: INV-19 (prices freeze when a document is raised from another) and INV-13 (cash and credit are not transferable between customers). The two invariants nothing else exercises — this scenario exists because the evidence map said so.

steps.notes: quoted at the list price of the day: 100.00/unit
the list price moves while the quote is out — a logged act, because WHEN it moved is part of the record
INV-19: the customer accepted 100.00/unit, so that is what the order carries — the whole reason the quote existed
a fresh document takes the new list price — the freeze protects raised documents, it does not fossilize the catalog
INV-19 held all the way to billing; INV-2 kept both prices on the line, so the 20.00/unit discount-vs-current-list is derivable, never invisible
INV-13: INV-0001 is Adventure Works' invoice. However tempting the tidy-up, cash stays with the customer who paid it

args.reason: gesture for the price change confusion

steps.notes: INV-13 covers credit too: Adventure Works' credit note cannot settle Blue Yonder's invoice
applied where it belongs; INV-0002 derives paid (INV-20)
